---- MODULE W4Od0m1p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS RingSize, LongestCase, SlowMinimum

ASSUME RingSize \in Nat \ {0}
ASSUME SlowMinimum <= LongestCase

Teams == 0 .. RingSize - 1
Stages == {"idle", "waiting", "operating", "closing"}

VARIABLES stage, theatre, clock, slow, token

vars == <<stage, theatre, clock, slow, token>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ stage \in [Teams -> Stages]
    /\ theatre \in {"clean", "in-use", "dirty"}
    /\ clock \in [Teams -> 0 .. LongestCase]
    /\ slow \in [Teams -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ token \in Teams

Init ==
    /\ stage = [t \in Teams |-> "idle"]
    /\ theatre = "clean"
    /\ clock = [t \in Teams |-> 0]
    /\ slow = [t \in Teams |-> FALSE]
    /\ token = 0

Operating == {t \in Teams : stage[t] = "operating"}

\* A slow team owes a longer minimum in the room; it is never timed out.
MinimumFor(t) == IF slow[t] THEN SlowMinimum ELSE 1

Request(t) ==
    /\ stage[t] = "idle"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![t] = "waiting"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<theatre, clock, slow, token>>

SetPace(t, fast) ==
    /\ stage[t] = "idle"
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![t] = fast]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, theatre, clock, token>>

Enter(t) ==
    /\ token = t
    /\ stage[t] = "waiting"
    /\ theatre = "clean"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![t] = "operating"]
    /\ theatre' = "in-use"
    /\ clock' = [clock EXCEPT ![t] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slow, token>>

Tick(t) ==
    /\ stage[t] = "operating"
    /\ clock[t] < LongestCase
    /\ clock' = [clock EXCEPT ![t] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, theatre, slow, token>>

Close(t) ==
    /\ stage[t] = "operating"
    /\ clock[t] >= MinimumFor(t)
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![t] = "closing"]
    /\ theatre' = "dirty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, slow, token>>

Turnover(t) ==
    /\ stage[t] = "closing"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
    /\ theatre' = "clean"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, slow, token>>

\* The token is never wrenched away from a team that is still in the room.
PassToken ==
    /\ stage[token] \notin {"operating", "closing"}
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % RingSize
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, theatre, clock, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Request(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, b \in BOOLEAN : SetPace(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Enter(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Tick(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Close(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Turnover(t)
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Whoever is in the theatre is the token holder, and the theatre's own
\* status agrees with that; two teams can never be in the room together.
TheatreHeldByTokenHolder ==
    /\ Operating \subseteq {token}
    /\ (theatre = "in-use") <=> (Operating # {})

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    RingSize = 3
    LongestCase = 2
    SlowMinimum = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT TheatreHeldByTokenHolder
nl:
A hospital has one operating theatre and several surgical teams that all need it. The theatre is the critical resource: exactly one team may be operating in it at any moment, and the consequence of getting that wrong is two teams walking into the same room with two patients.

Access is arbitrated by a physical scheduling token that circulates around the teams in a fixed ring. A team may only wheel a patient in while the token is with it and the theatre has been turned over and is clean. Once a team is in the theatre, the token stays with that team: it cannot be passed on while its holder is operating or still closing up. Only when the holder is back to waiting or idle does the token move on to the next team in the ring.

Teams are allowed to be slow but are never allowed to disappear. A team that is running slow -- a difficult case, a trainee list -- simply takes longer in the theatre: it must clock a longer minimum time before it can close. It does not fail, does not have to be timed out, and the token is never wrenched away from it. A team's pace is set while it is idle and holds for the case it then takes on.

Turnover matters: when a team closes, the theatre is left dirty, and it is only clean again after that same team's turnover completes and the team goes back to idle. Nobody can enter a dirty theatre.

The full set of actions is: Request, in which an idle team decides it needs the theatre and starts waiting; SetPace, in which an idle team is marked as running slow or as running normally; Enter, in which the team holding the token, if it is waiting and the theatre is clean, wheels in, marks the theatre in use, and starts its clock at zero; Tick, in which a team that is operating advances its clock by one, up to the longest case the model allows; Close, in which an operating team that has clocked at least the minimum for its pace stops operating, leaves the theatre dirty, and begins turnover; Turnover, in which a closing team finishes cleaning, the theatre becomes clean again, and the team returns to idle; and PassToken, in which the token moves to the next team in the ring, allowed only when its current holder is neither operating nor closing.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The set of teams currently operating is always a subset of the single-element set containing the token holder, and the theatre reads as in use exactly when some team is operating in it -- so the theatre is never occupied by two teams, and never occupied by anyone who is not holding the scheduling token.
